exposure: FCGR gene variations (FCGR3A gene duplication, FcgRIIb-232TT genotype, FcgRIIIb-HNA1a, FCGR2A polymorphisms, FCGR3A polymorphisms)
cohort: Black South African infants born to women living with HIV-1, who were either perinatally HIV-1 acquired (cases, n=395) or HIV-1 exposed uninfected (controls, n=312), and received nevirapine for prevention of MTCT.
finding: The FcgRIIb-232TT genotype, FCGR3A gene duplication, and homozygous FcgRIIIb-HNA1a were associated with an increased risk of perinatal HIV-1 acquisition in infants.
birth_weight: Measured and adjusted for in the analysis, but no specific range or criteria mentioned for inclusion.
